verdict.rationale: Zapier documents a developer platform for building integrations: you design triggers and actions, wire up authentication, and publish. Its Platform CLI supports Node.js, OAuth1/OAuth2, webhooks, polling triggers and HTTP middleware, with a Visual Builder as a no-code alternative. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of private (unpublished) integration sharing, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI build workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a custom connector or private integration with a documented developer platform, SDK, or CLI

citations.quote: Build a Zapier integration - design triggers and actions for your product, wire up authentication, then publish to the App Directory.
Zapier Platform CLI enables developers to build integrations using Node.js v22, OAuth1/OAuth2 authentication, webhooks, polling triggers, and HTTP middleware.
Use the Visual Builder for quick, no-code setups or the CLI for full control and customization.
